The '''Lava Dragon Isle''' is a members-only section of the [[Wilderness]] which stretches from level 36 to level 42. It is a [[Multicombat area]], and the only place where [[lava dragon]]s spawn.

==Transportation==
The main entrance is located at the northern point of the isle, and players can reach it either by using a [[Revenant cave teleport]] and heading north-east, or the [[Annakarl Teleport]] to the [[Demonic Ruins]] and heading south-west.

Alternatively, there is an agility shortcut at the southern point of the isle, which requires 74 [[Agility]] to use. Players with level 57 [[Woodcutting]] can take a [[canoe]] to the [[Wilderness Pond]] to the south-west, and run east to reach the shortcut.

==Features==
The isle is filled with charred skeletons and [[big egg]]s. There are 8 [[lava dragons]] which spawn on the isle, and it is recommended for all players to bring some form of antifire protection such as an [[anti-dragon shield]].

There are safespots if players wish to train on the dragons using [[Ranged]], [[Magic]], or a [[halberd]], and their valuable drops make the area a hotspot for both PvMers and [[PKer]]s. Burying the [[lava dragon bones]] on the isle also grants 340 [[Prayer]] experience instead of the normal 85 experience, making it a reasonable method of training Prayer as well.

There are also [[white berries]] spawns which have a fast respawn rate - players often collect these to sell for a reasonable profit.

Finally, a [[STASH]] unit by the eastern edge of the isle can be found, which is used for players directed there during a [[Clue scroll (master)|master]] Treasure Trail. This STASH is filled with a [[dragon med helm]], [[rune platebody]], uncharged [[amulet of glory]], [[brine sabre]] and a [[Toktz-ket-xil]].

[[William]] can be found near the entrance selling [[team cape]]s 1, 11, 21, 31, and 41.

==Item spawns==
*[[White berries]] - 2 to the south-east.
*A [[Black dagger]] to the south-west.
*5 [[coins]] - 2 spawns to the south-west.
*[[Vial]] - 2 to the north-west.
*[[Burnt bones]] - Multiple spawns around the isle.
